BRAND_DESCRIPTION: Second hand in Fuerteventura: send it on WhatsApp and we post it.
HOME_HERO_TEXT: What you no longer use, someone else wants. Send us a photo on WhatsApp and we'll post it for you.
WORKSHOP_INTRO: No accounts, no forms: just WhatsApp. We do the rest.
WORKSHOP_STEP_1_TEXT: Send a photo of what you want to sell on WhatsApp and, if you like, the price and a few words.
WORKSHOP_STEP_2_TEXT: We improve the photo, write the listing and review it. You get a link to see it and choose your listing.
WORKSHOP_STEP_3_TEXT: Pay by card or PayPal and your listing goes online for 3 months. Buyers write to you directly.
STORE_EMPTY: Listings are coming soon. Want to be the first? Write to us on WhatsApp.
FOOTER_TAGLINE: Second hand in Fuerteventura, on WhatsApp.
